CANDIDATE AC4-S1 mote:bd-01M37AMS9NYY9J0FWJESVPJ56E (child of bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF), within your #86 seq749 boundary.
Branch claude-p1/ac4-s1-sampled-frames, tip 4ce39ec1, a primary-repo ref and a fast-forward of main c600dd90.
Commits:
- e20d7e5a: ADR 0007 amendment (SD5)
- 6227e341: consumer test first, in package storymodel4s.probe (T6)
- 7dfc7db1: implementation
- 97d98e27: cold-review repair
- 4ce39ec1: evidence, docs/refactor/evidence/ac4-s1-sampled-frames-20260923/
WHAT:
- New sealed IdentifiedFrames (FrameSet | SampledFrameSet) with sample index vs presentation ordinal named apart; time only via the presentation ordinal.
- SampledFrameSet.join refuses at sampled-frames/selection, membership and bytes.
- CaptionSearch.join(frames, req, out, worker, expected: EditionId) refuses at caption/edition (full and sampled), caption/unsampled (before reading the outcome) and caption/extent-shape (forged extents re-admitted via CaptionExtent.of). Extents close on their own samples. CaptionProposal gains presentationOrdinals.
- FrameSet admission is unchanged. One full-path key change: ordinal beyond the decode is now caption/unsampled, was caption/request; stated in the ADR and pinned by a test.
- Algorithm vlm-caption-proposals/v2 -> v3. Draft throughout. Callers: media tests only; storyatlas4s does not use media.
EVIDENCE (LocallyObserved):
- reference-scope names media only (JVM, so no #16 needed).
- Exact-SHA export of 91d1ba3f (rebased onto b737b14f, after build.sbt/core moved): media/test with tlFatalWarnings gives 62 total, 59 passed, 3 skipped (live worker), 0 failed; TEST_EXIT=0; scalafmtCheckAll+SbtCheck FMT_EXIT=0.
- The later rebase onto c600dd90 is .mote/docs only (gate-inert); frames.scala, caption.scala and the suite are byte-identical.
- 9 named mutants, each compiled and failing exactly its named test (Failed: Total 1); controls 10/10 before and after; receipt bound to the source sha256.
- SD6 cold review: 1 BLOCK found and fixed (forged out-of-order extent admitted a hull omitting a shown frame; empty extent threw; pre-existing on the full path too). The named test is red at 960015a1 and green now. 3 follow-ups fixed. 1 filed: bd-01M37D2JPGXRTVF37PN417JW1Y (request binds selection; CaptionExtent unforgeable).
NOT established: that a tool run produced the samples (S3 witness).
Please name an independent reviewer for the exact tip.
